# ColdiMail ### Intelligent Faculty Outreach & Research Matching Engine

Graduate applicant outreach is broken. ColdiMail is building the modern standard.

--- ## ⏳ Launch Announcement: ~30 Days Remaining We are putting the finishing touches on **ColdiMail**. The closed pre-launch phase is underway, and public beta access will open in **~30 days**! ⭐ **Star and Watch this repository** to receive real-time notifications the moment early access invites and public onboarding go live. --- ## 💥 The Problem with Academic Outreach Every admissions and funding cycle, tens of thousands of qualified Master's, PhD, and postdoctoral candidates face an exhausting dilemma: * **The Copy-Paste Trap:** Professors receive dozens of generic outreach emails daily and filter them out in seconds. Generic "spray-and-pray" simply does not work. * **The Manual Bottleneck:** Thoroughly reading a principal investigator's recent papers, identifying current lab grants, and tailoring an email with genuine research synergy takes 1–2 hours per professor. At scale, applicants burn out after just a handful of emails. * **Lost Opportunities:** High-potential applicants miss out on dream labs and funded positions purely because the manual discovery and communication process is overwhelming and disjointed. --- ## 💡 How ColdiMail Changes the Game ColdiMail transforms academic cold emailing from a blind numbers game into a **high-precision, context-rich matching system**: | Traditional Outreach | With ColdiMail | | :--- | :--- | | Hours spent hunting through scattered lab websites | Instant discovery of research labs aligned with your specific interests | | Skimming dense papers to find matching topics | Automatic synthesis of active lab themes, recent publications, and focus areas | | Awkward, generic email templates | Deeply contextualized drafts demonstrating authentic research synergy | | Disorganized spreadsheets and forgotten follow-ups | Centralized campaign tracking with respectful, timed follow-up management | --- ## 🚀 Core Capabilities ### 🔍 Precision Lab & Faculty Discovery Quickly identify universities, departments, and principal investigators whose active research directions directly match your academic background and graduate goals. ### 📄 Contextual Research Alignment Synthesize recent publications and active lab directions to highlight authentic overlaps between your research experiences and the professor's ongoing projects. ### ✍️ High-Impact, Tailored Communication Generate thoughtful, articulate email drafts that respect the professor's time, communicate your technical strengths, and avoid sounding like marketing spam or mass-sent templates. ### 📊 Structured Workflow & Follow-Up Management Manage your entire application cycle in one cohesive hub. Track outbound correspondence, prevent duplicate contact across shared labs, and schedule polite follow-up reminders. --- ## 🎯 Who Is ColdiMail For? * **Prospective Graduate Students (MS / PhD):** Seeking funded research assistantships, supervisor sponsorship, and lab placements. * **Postdoctoral Scholars:** Initiating contact with prospective PIs and research groups worldwide. * **Visiting Researchers & Research Interns:** Connecting with university faculty for summer or term-time research positions. --- ## 🗺️ Launch Roadmap - [x] **Phase 1: Architecture & Research Alignment Engine** - [x] **Phase 2: Intelligent Drafting & Context Synthesis** - [ ] **Phase 3: Private Closed Beta & Early Feedback** *(In Progress)* - [ ] **Phase 4: Public Pre-Launch Rollout** *(~30 Days Remaining)* --- ## 🔔 Stay Informed Don't miss the launch: 1. **Star this repository** ⭐ at the top right to bookmark ColdiMail. 2. **Click "Watch" → Custom → Releases** to get notified instantly when the first public release is announced. ---
Engineered by Ahmad Hassan (B-Ted)
